evals.prompt: 把文档 A 的第 X~Y 章插入/替换文档 B，格式以 B（模板）为准。
evals.expected_output: Uses the template as the ZIP base, performs body-element surgery on document.xml, and remaps styles by name.
assertions: Copies the format-authority docx as base
Remaps pStyle/rStyle by style name, not styleId

evals.prompt: 合并后样式全乱，正文渲染成标题样式，图注变超链接样式。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses styleId-name mismatch across documents and verifies the remap function is actually invoked.
assertions: Builds styleId -> name -> base styleId mapping
Verifies pStyle distribution contains only base styleIds

evals.prompt: 合并后图/表编号跳号，要按文档顺序重算 SEQ 域静态结果。
evals.expected_output: Renumbers SEQ fields statefully, handling split instrText runs and labeling by 图/表 tag characters.
assertions: Handles instrText split across multiple runs
Renumbers by document order and verifies continuity

evals.prompt: 设计条目 SD 编号乱序重复，要重排并同步追踪矩阵和正文引用。
evals.expected_output: Builds a single-source mapping, renumbers by index, syncs the traceability matrix by design name, and resweeps independently.
assertions: Uses index-based mapping not old-value dictionary
Resweeps output for unique contiguous numbering

evals.prompt: 创建一份简单的 Word 文档。
evals.expected_output: Routes simple docx creation to the bundled docx skill.
assertions: Routes to the basic docx skill

evals.prompt: 修订 markdown 文档的术语与结构。
evals.expected_output: Routes markdown text revision to ada-docs-revision.

evals.prompt: 读取 docx 里的文字内容做摘要。
evals.expected_output: Routes document reading to the bundled docx skill.
assertions: Routes to the basic docx skill

evals.prompt: 编写 SRS 需求条目。
evals.expected_output: Treats this as requirements authoring, not document merging.
